staying in after a skin treatment in Seoul?

You'll want snacks in the room. Korean drugstores sell plenty. Every pack prints its calories and sodium on the back, and that small label tells you more than anything on the front.

What the packs shown here say:
Konjac water jelly: 0 kcal a pouch.
Freeze-dried strawberry chips: 25 kcal a bag.
Protein shakes: about 160 to 185 kcal each.

Chips vary a lot. Check the sodium line before you buy.

Save this for your trip, and show it to the staff if you can't find something.

Not sponsored. General education only, not a product recommendation.
